DashboardHeliusRings.title: Helius Rings
DashboardHeliusRings.subtitle: Shielded wallets and private transfers on Solana devnet.
DashboardHeliusRings.devnetBanner: Devnet only — Helius Rings runs exclusively on Solana devnet. Nothing here touches mainnet funds.

workspace.selectPrompt: Select a private wallet above to see its details, operations, and activity.

overview.failed: Balance could not be read. Try again from the wallet's row.

ring.title: Custom rings
ring.description: Named custom rings for this project. Ops deploys each ring program and hands over its id; recording a name and id here completes bring-up (auditor key, ring config, read access, lookup table) through custody. Once active, any operation can target the ring by name — default-ring operations are never blocked by it.
ring.none: No custom rings recorded. All operations use the default ring.
ring.dialogDescription: Select a ring to see its program, auditor key, and lookup table.
ring.programIdPlaceholder: Base58 program id from the ops deployment
ring.repointHint: Re-submitting a recorded name resumes its bring-up. Entering a different id under that name replaces its program, which is possible only while the ring has never been active.
ring.explain_pending: Bring-up has not completed. Operations cannot target this ring yet; default-ring operations are unaffected.
ring.explain_failed: Bring-up failed; operations cannot target this ring until a retry succeeds. Default-ring operations are unaffected.

wallets.title: Private wallets
wallets.description: One custody wallet backs one shielded identity.
wallets.name: Name
wallets.createFailed: The wallet could not be created. Check the details and try again.
wallets.noCustodyWallets: No custody wallets available. Create a wallet under Wallets first.
wallets.allCustodyWalletsBound: Every custody wallet already backs a private wallet.

identity.reading: Reading the on-chain registry record for this wallet's owner.
identity.readFailed: The on-chain record could not be read. Retry shortly.
identity.explain_unregistered: The registry holds no record for this wallet's owner, so provisioning will create one. Nothing on chain is in the way.
identity.explain_ours: The published record is the identity this deployment derives, so provisioning already succeeded on chain and only this row is behind. Retry provisioning to record it.
identity.explain_foreign: The registry already publishes a different identity for this owner. Provisioning will refuse rather than re-key it, because re-keying would orphan every note encrypted to the published keys. SDP does not rotate an identity, so the fix is to bind this private wallet to a different custody wallet.

balances.readFailed: The shielded balance could not be read. Retry shortly.

recovery.voidConfirm: Voiding asserts this signed transaction never landed on chain and releases the wallet's spend slot. Continue only if you have reconciled the signature and confirmed absence.
